In the Microsoft Defender portal's Advanced hunting page, data is accessible via queries for
only 30 days, unless it's streamed through Microsoft Sentinel, where retention periods may be
longer.
Data continues to be retained and visible, even when a license is under a grace period or in
suspended mode. At the end of any grace period or suspension, and no later than 180 days
from a contract termination or expiration, data is deleted from Microsoft's systems and is
unrecoverable.
Most Defender services also have a default data retention period of 180 days. More
information on data retention period per product is found in relevant service docs.
Microsoft Defender XDR shares data among the following Microsoft products, also licensed by
the customer. For customers in the Government Community Cloud (GCC), data sharing
between government and commercial cloud environments may occur, depending on the
location of the service offering.
Microsoft Defender for Cloud
Microsoft Defender for Identity
Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps
Microsoft Defender for Office 365
Microsoft Defender for IoT
Microsoft Sentinel
Microsoft Intune
Microsoft Purview
Microsoft Entra
Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management
Microsoft Copilot for Security
